## Example files

Build your own file. Use these examples to check a step when you are stuck, then return to your work. Do not submit the example files unchanged. Designated Project 4 analysis, volume and contouring groups may be reused directly in your own project. Select the lesson object; press Home over the node editor to see the graph. Follow the Frames in order. Change inputs on the nodes or, where provided, in the GeometryNodes modifier.

Prepared in **Blender 5.2.1 LTS**. Earlier Blender versions may lack the volume nodes used in the later classes.

**[Descriptive Geometry]({{ site.baseurl }}/files/blender/02-geometry-fundamentals/GEOMETRY101-class-ready.blend)** — download .blend

1. Point
2. Line
3. Edge
4. Face
5. Solid
6. Boolean

Follow the six main teaching scenes. Original reference scenes remain in the file. The pyramid keeps Width, Depth and Height exposed and the file ends with cube-minus-pyramid. This is a model-units lesson, not a fabrication export.

**Practice:** Show a point, line, edge, face, solid pyramid and cube-minus-pyramid result. Keep Width, Depth and Height exposed; include a mesh with multiple faces.
